name: culinary-alchemy
description: Culinary Alchemy monorepo — web dev client, native Steam (egui), native iOS (SwiftUI), native Android (Compose)

scripts.build: npm run export-native && npm run build --workspace @culinary-alchemy/web
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run export-native && cargo run -p culinary-desktop
scripts.desktop:build: npm run export-native && cargo build -p culinary-desktop --release
scripts.android:build: npm run android:assets && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:install: npm run android:build && cd android && ./gradlew installDebug
